description: Landlord demands security deposit exceeding legal limit
right: Tenant can only be charged up to 3 months rent as deposit
remedy: Excess deposit must be refunded within 30 days of vacating

description: Agreement prohibits tenant from vacating before a fixed period
right: Lock-in period must be mutually agreed and cannot exceed 11 months without registration
remedy: Tenant can challenge unreasonable lock-in at Rent Tribunal

description: Annual rent increase clause beyond permissible limit
right: Rent increase capped at 10% per year under Karnataka law
remedy: File complaint with Rent Controller if increase exceeds 10%

description: Clause allowing landlord to enter premises without notice
right: Landlord must give minimum 24 hours written notice before entry
remedy: Tenant can refuse entry and report harassment to police

description: Unfair termination notice period shorter than legal minimum
right: Minimum 1 month written notice required from either party
remedy: Eviction without notice is invalid, tenant can approach Rent Tribunal

description: All maintenance costs unilaterally imposed on tenant
right: Major structural repairs are landlord's responsibility
remedy: Tenant can deduct repair costs from rent if landlord refuses after written notice

description: Disproportionate penalties for minor breaches by tenant
right: Penalty must be reasonable and not punitive
remedy: Court can reduce unreasonable penalty to actual damages

description: Absolute ban on subletting without any provision for landlord consent
right: Tenant may sublet with written landlord consent
remedy: Blanket bans without consent mechanism may be challenged

description: Landlord charges above meter reading or adds arbitrary utility fees
right: Tenant pays only actual meter-based consumption at government tariff
remedy: Dispute inflated bills with BESCOM and deduct from rent

statute: No specific statute — governed by contract law
right: Enforceable if agreed at signing, but excessive penalties challengeable
remedy: Challenge disproportionate pet penalties under Contract Act Section 74

description: Tenant required to repaint entire flat at own cost before vacating
right: Tenant responsible only for damage beyond normal wear and tear
remedy: Refuse deduction from deposit; approach Small Causes Court if deducted

description: Landlord can terminate without cause at any time
right: Landlord needs valid grounds (non-payment, personal use, demolition) for eviction
remedy: Challenge arbitrary eviction at Rent Tribunal

right: Leases over 11 months MUST be registered; unregistered lease is inadmissible as evidence
remedy: Insist on registration at sub-registrar office; costs shared equally

description: Clause allowing landlord to seize tenant goods for unpaid rent
statute: No valid statutory basis in Karnataka
right: Landlord cannot seize goods without court order
remedy: File FIR for theft if landlord seizes goods; approach Rent Tribunal

description: Clause forcing arbitration in city other than tenant's residence
right: Arbitration venue must be reasonable and not oppressive
remedy: Challenge venue in High Court; Karnataka courts have jurisdiction
